description:
We are NasaTwisters, a team from Monterrey, Mexico, who built FlameTrace for the "Flame in Freefall" challenge. We share an interest in space exploration, trustworthy AI and data you can verify.

We believe AI should make science more reliable, not less: every number we show comes from code and traces back to NASA's data, we would welcome people with experience in combustion or fire-safety engineering, machine-learning evaluation, and UX design to keep improving FlameTrace.
